name: 企业微信智能总结
desc: WeCom feature that turns scattered threads into a weekly digest.
desc_zh: 把散落的客户线索汇成周报的企业微信功能。
solves: What you know about a customer is spread across chats, docs, and meetings. Smart summaries turn it into a weekly digest you can search.
solves_zh: 关于一个客户的信息散落在聊天、文档和会议里。智能总结把这些线索汇成可检索的每周简报。
best_for: Sales and service teams whose customer history lives in WeCom conversations and meetings.
best_for_zh: 客户历史都留在企业微信会话里的销售和服务团队。
notes: 集成在 企业微信 内的能力。来源：https://work.weixin.qq.com/nl/index/aioffice
